verdict.rationale: CAM has a Prarambh FAQ page and a general blogs hub with legal thought-leadership, but the FAQ content is narrowly about incubator program logistics (cohort duration, eligibility, mentorship) rather than a broad plain-language knowledge base on startup formation, financing, and equity; the blogs hub covers practice areas generally, not startup-specific explainers. Missing for 10: dedicated formation/financing/equity explainer content for founders, cap-table or equity guides, independent corroboration of a genuine self-serve knowledge base.
